I’m having an issue when selling to the Quartermaster using Show me the money quick sell. When trying to sell it’ll show a pop-up wit the error: [TheQuartermaster] Could not list item <itemID>: it may exceed the max allowed stack size.

comments.author: shaneeexd
comments.body_html: Some items can’t be listed (exceeding per-item quantity caps, non-stackable categories, excluded item types, etc.), which triggers that error. This is expected behaviour, not a bug. The “Show Me The Money” quick sell mod works fine for items that are eligible for listing, for items that aren’t, you’ll get that message. You most likely are trying to sell an item which already has maximum listings, the default max listings per item (excluding ammo) is 5, to ensure the trader has a varied stock.
